staging: First layouts0/1:12 branches and first frozen table; then layouts2/3:12 branches; only then8 complete matched policy runs.
full_runs: S_visibility versus S_acquisition ×4 layouts; neutral class prior evaluated on same short candidate data.
fair_geometry: Frozen B9T16 full positive structure/geometry posterior and identical original0.22m surface quadrature, fitted only from acquired measurements. Do not substitute B10 conditional-mean geometry in primary comparison.
primary_estimator_difference: Original repaired point visibility/history expected area versus prediction-only RGBD/TSDF acquisition gross-new area on the identical per-hypothesis surface basis. Same class prior, geometry, common score, candidate provider and execution contract.

short_candidate_design.rule: On original native routes and before reading prediction gains or outcome truth, choose the largest outbound-action cost band of width3actions; ties choose lower band then lower ordered candidate IDs. Require at least3 routes. Rank old/new S within that shared cost-matched pool, retain both selected routes and fill to3 by ascending original candidate ID. Re-rank neutral/semantic priors on that final shared3 for all matched diagnostics.
short_candidate_design.winner_definition: Actual maximizer in this declared controlled short-replay pool, not a claim to be the winner over every original full-run route.
short_candidate_design.best_area_definition: Best actual gross-new object area among the3 executed short branches; not global-optimal or best-over-unexecuted route evidence.
short_candidate_design.infeasible_band: Keep as protocol preparation failure with route costs; do not replace states/layouts using outcomes. No widening after gains.
short_candidate_design.full_policy: The controlled cost band is used only for short replay; complete runs keep all original native candidates.

prefix_rule: Scene generator predetermines two legal acquisition prefixes without prediction gains or future outcome metrics; freeze all paths and states before either estimator scores them.
execution: Every short branch begins from exactly reconstructed same acquired prefix; actual trajectory/frames/TSDF reused by both estimators; frozen actions shared per route; preserve failures and interruptions.
metrics: object gross new/lost/net reference surface area5cm
scope_limits: Four new controlled layouts across two topologies with reused authored furniture assets, noiseless exact poses and ideal visible categories/instances; not four independent natural sensor environments. Unknown coverage remains primary and no source reference enters gain or prefix/candidate selection.
scene_limitations: Central0.2m-wide opening can transmit rays but is not robot-traversable; robot room graph is chain or cycle as declared.
Inherited radius-zero occupancy queries can miss exact wall-boundary grid points; reference reachable robot-center free set and sampled mesh surface references are independently checked.
